title: Security and Protective Services
agency_path: City of New York > Campaign Finance Board
submit_to: 100 Church Street, 12th Floor, New York, NY 10007
description_text:
The NYC Campaign Finance Board (CFB) is seeking a fully licensed security contractor to provide unarmed, uniformed security and protective services for the agency at its offices located on the 12th and 20th floors of 100 Church Street in Lower Manhattan, NYC.

This procurement will be utilizing the M/WBE Noncompetitive Small Purchase method, in accordance with PPB Rule Section § 3-08(c)(1)(iv), and is open to businesses certified as NYC Minority- or Women-Owned Business Enterprises (M/WBEs) pursuant to New York City Charter Section 311(i)(1).
